items.text: EXTERNAL ENVIRONMENT Under the $ 7 billion IMF EFF program, the structural reforms undertaken to reduce public debt and strengthen SBP FX reserves has led to economic stabilization. Investor confidence has improved with rating upgrades by S&P, Moody’s, and Fitch. The Sovereign Eurobond spreads have narrowed back to historical levels of around 500 basis points, which will open the international credit markets for Pakistan, which is targeting new issuance in 2026. Similarly, the stock market has rallied with gains of over 47,000 points (60%YoY) to 125,627 points at the end of FY2025.
